```python
import heapq

def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    threshold = case["utility_threshold"]
    
    # Build lookup and children mapping
    node_map = {}
    children = {}
    for node in nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        node_map[nid] = node
        children[nid] = []
    for node in nodes:
        parent = node.get("parent")
        if parent is not None:
            children[parent].append(node["id"])
    
    removed = set()
    # Initial heap: (-depth, id) for depth descending, then id ascending
    heap = []
    for node in nodes:
        heapq.heappush(heap, (-node["depth"], node["id"]))
    
    visit_order = []
    
    while heap:
        neg_depth, nid = heapq.heappop(heap)
        visit_order.append(nid)
        if nid in removed:
            continue
        node = node_map[nid]
        # check if leaf: all children removed
        leaf = all(child in removed for child in children.get(nid, []))
        if leaf and node["removable"] and node["utility"] <= threshold:
            removed.add(nid)
            parent_id = node.get("parent")
            if parent_id is not None and parent_id not in removed:
                parent_node = node_map[parent_id]
                heapq.heappush(heap, (-parent_node["depth"], parent_id))
    
    retained = [node["id"] for node in nodes if node["id"] not in removed]
    return {"retained_node_ids": retained, "visit_order": visit_order}
```
